assessment: This study presents a useful finding for the ferroptosis-mediated tumor microenvironment (TME) in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) using public single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and bulk RNA sequencing data. The data were collected and analyzed using solid and validated methodology and can be used as a starting point for functional studies of TME in TNBC. The work will be of interest to medical biologists working in the field of TNBC.
